scope: Tesla Charge Companion V9 German CPO first-pass

this_pass.evidence: Current official Westfalen Weser direct-access page explicitly supports ad-hoc QR, Girocard and terminal payment without prior registration. The same official page publishes the direct tariff: AC normal charging EUR 0.35 per start plus EUR 0.55/kWh and EUR 0.00/h; DC fast charging EUR 0.35 per start plus EUR 0.67/kWh and EUR 0.00/h. The contractual counterparty is explicitly Westfalen Weser Ladeservice GmbH.

Current official E-Mobility FAQ explicitly states that charging at Stadtwerke Winsen stations without contract by SMS or QR code costs EUR 0.60/kWh. The same FAQ separately lists card pricing and warns that prices at foreign stations can differ, so the direct tariff is scoped only to own stations.

Current official Cell-E-Mobil page confirms the operator's public charging network and advertises a tariff 'from EUR 0.40/kWh' without publishing an exact direct-payment matrix. Current Mobilithek/DATEX-II-derived station data for sampled Stadtwerke Celle AC EVSEs shows direct payment around EUR 0.56/kWh plus EUR 1.00 start fee, but this station-level value is not generalized because the official current page does not establish its network-wide scope and other Celle sites have different operator attribution.
this_pass.reason: official public CPO and lower-bound tariff confirmed; exact current direct/ad-hoc matrix is not published and station-level open-data observations are not generalized

this_pass.evidence: Current Stadtwerke Osnabrück pages confirm OPG as the Stadtwerke subsidiary operating roughly 150 public charging points in Osnabrück and the region, including newly commissioned DC sites in 2025-2026. The current public pages promote the OPG E-LadeCard and direct charging infrastructure but do not publish a numeric current contract-free station/EVSE tariff. Station aggregators confirm ad-hoc availability at sampled sites but no reliable official numeric direct matrix was established.
this_pass.reason: operator identity and public network are official; no current official numeric ad-hoc/direct-payment tariff matrix established in first pass

this_pass.evidence: Current official Stadtwerke Wolfenbüttel material confirms the utility has built and operated public charging infrastructure in Wolfenbüttel and continues to offer e-mobility services, but the 2026 web surface exposes home/business charging solutions rather than a numeric public ad-hoc tariff. Current station-level discovery reports values around EUR 0.49/kWh AC and EUR 0.64/kWh DC on sampled sites, but operator/backend attribution includes legacy partners and the values are not generalized.
this_pass.reason: public charging activity confirmed but no current official numeric direct/ad-hoc matrix; sampled third-party values have legacy operator/backend attribution risk
